_what: How computer/confined-run.mjs runs a program on this Mac under a generated Seatbelt (sandbox-exec) profile. The profile starts from `allow default` and then takes away: every file write except the roots a tier names plus `always_writable`, every read of the credential folders, and the network when the tier says so. `{workspace}` in a tier is the folder the caller names; `{tmp}` is this run's temporary folder; `~` is the home folder. A tier is a row; a new confinement is one more row. `env_allow` are the only variable names a program inherits (a caller adds named scoped values beside them, never in arguments). `pin` checks a program before it runs: its BLAKE3 and/or the Team ID of its code signature.

tiers.label: Writes only in the workspace and the temporary folder, no network
Writes only in the workspace and the temporary folder, may use the network

words.unknown_tier: There is no confinement named {tier} on this Mac.
words.pin_blake3: {program} is not the program pinned for this run (its content differs), so it was not started.
words.pin_team: {program} is not signed by the pinned developer ({team}), so it was not started.
words.no_sandbox: This Mac has no sandbox-exec, so the run was not started.
